verdict.rationale: The IRS runs real machine channels. Modernized e-File is a system-to-system rail that 'uses the widely accepted Extensible Markup Language (XML) format', and IRIS offers an Application-to-Application intake, which implies an XML-based machine contract. However, the evidence never shows that XML schemas or a data dictionary are actually published, and every OpenAPI probe returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of published MeF/IRIS XML schema packages (XSDs) or business rules, a data dictionary for the A2A channel, any OpenAPI or machine-readable spec at a discoverable location, and independent confirmation that developers can obtain the specs.
